Some lesions appear to have raised centers, characteristic of pustules. Comparing these visual cues with the provided symptom descriptions, the best match is Bacterial Pustule. The description for Bacterial Pustule mentions "small, light green spots...with raised centers" and that "lesions can grow together into large irregular brown areas." This aligns well with the visual evidence. Other diseases like Brown Spot or Bacterial Blight have different lesion characteristics (e.g., angular spots, water-soaking, distinct halos) that are less consistent with the image.
